one_liner.zh: 检查并清理 Git 仓库中已合并或冗余的分支
one_liner.en: Inspect and clean merged or redundant Git branches

local: Requires Bash and Git in the host environment; merged-PR detection optionally uses an authenticated gh CLI.

completeness.reason: Registration exposes a focused branch inspection and cleanup tool with configurable detection and reporting.

code.reason: Arguments are normalized, reports are parsed into a stable shape, and timeout and cancellation paths are handled.

docs.reason: README gives installation, usage, parameter descriptions, and output details.

maintenance.reason: The recorded history has eight commits; the repository was created and last pushed on the same day.

tests.reason: One test file contains cases for the tool wrapper and branch-cleanup behavior.

quality.notes: C-lite scope; the bundled implementation and host wrapper were read, but auxiliary scripts were skipped.
